claims.value: Sitter: a musician (Franchino Gaffurio, Josquin des Prez, Atalante Migliorotti proposed)
claims.statement: The sitter is now usually seen as a musician because of the sheet of music; names proposed include Franchino Gaffurio, Josquin des Prez, and more recently Atalante Migliorotti (per the Ambrosiana page). Each is an identification by individual scholars, to be traced.

claims.value: Face by Leonardo; extent of his participation debated (Boltraffio and others proposed for parts)
claims.statement: The draft states the face is generally accepted as Leonardo's and the rest debated; holders of each position (including proposals of workshop hands) not checked in this session.

claims.value: Probably entered the Ambrosiana with the Galeazzo Arconati donation of 1637
claims.statement: A search summary of Ambrosiana material says the panel probably came with Count Galeazzo Arconati's 1637 donation (with the Codex Atlanticus), and links it to Federico Borromeo's description of a 'portrait of a Duchess of Milan' by Leonardo. Both are reconstructions and conflict with other accounts that place it in Borromeo's 1618 foundation gift.
